title: PRE-RAID: PICK HOW MUCH CASH TO TAKE
why: His order (2026-10-15): "On the pre-raid screen (the map select screen, renamed PRE-RAID), quickly pick how much cash and how many of each wheel item to take, plus keys and guns." Cash was the open piece. The PACK row has a CASH chip with minus, plus and MAX (ALL and NONE set it too). The amount is the cash on him in the raid: the stall sells him no more than that (NOT ENOUGH CASH ON YOU), and banked Credits stay banked, nothing is lost with it. No pick means no cap, as before.
now: The PRE-RAID page has a CASH chip: pick how much cash goes up with you to spend at the stall.
